name: Alex Novara
headline: Software engineer building reliable web platforms and practical AI tools
shortBio: Alex is a **fictional** software engineer from the demo seed. Ten years of web platforms for logistics, retail and publishing, and lately agents, retrieval and evaluation.
longBio:
Alex Novara does not exist. This profile is the fictional demo seed of the repository, written so every page, the CV and the chatbot have realistic content to show.

The story: Alex started as a PHP developer at a regional freight company, moved to TypeScript platforms for retail and publishing, and runs a small consultancy on the side. Since 2024 Alex has been building and testing AI tools: retrieval over company documents, small agents with clear guardrails and evaluation suites that keep them honest.
availability: Open to one consulting engagement from the next quarter.
